BTC.note: Sold 2 Nov 2026 – no longer held; still watched for MSTR: Binance exchange hack (95% covered) and BTCPay drains, Bitcoin itself unaffected
BTC.detail: Bob sold his Bitcoin fund on 2 Nov 2026; this is watched only because MSTR depends on Bitcoin. Binance (an exchange) lost about US$6.3bn on 29-30 Oct to North Korea-linked hackers; it was not a flaw in Bitcoin. Binance says about 95% is replaced, withdrawals reopened in phases from 1 Nov (net outflow about US$3.6bn, 2.1% of assets), and a verifiable reserves proof is due about 3 Nov. The attacker's 18,270 stolen BTC have not moved; on 2 Nov the attacker split stolen XRP (~US$293m) into six wallets, a laundering step. Separately, BTCPay Server (merchant payment software) hot wallets were drained on versions 2.4.1 and older; latest 2.4.7 has no credible reports. This hits merchants' online wallets, not the Bitcoin network. Quantum: estimates keep falling but remain theoretical.

TSLA.detail: No confirmed Tesla breach. A Sept 2026 hacking-forum claim is unverified.

MSTR.detail: Strategy itself was not hacked. The Binance hack only moved its share price through Bitcoin.

SEMI.detail: No breaches at SEMI's top holdings. Intel's Israel factory explosion is an operations issue, not a security one.
